lines.text: You emphasized that in order to keep your company on the top, the employee should realize that there are other competitors having equally brainy engineers who are working on similar products.
Now, as a CEO of the company, what other motivation strategies do you have for the employees so that you can place on the top?

glossary.ex: She's the brainy one in the family.
glossary.vs: smart와 비슷하지만 조금 더 구어적이고 '공부머리'에 가깝다.

glossary.easy: 사람들이 더 열심히 하고 싶게 만드는 방법들
glossary.ex: Good managers use different motivation strategies.
glossary.exKo: 좋은 관리자는 다양한 동기 부여 전략을 쓴다.

lines.text: Yeah, first of all, as I say that, I just want to make sure that, you know, every single engineer of our company and every engineer that's in the audience understood what I've meant, OK?
It is true that there are great students everywhere.

glossary.easy: 여러 가지 중 가장 먼저 말하자면
glossary.ex: First of all, thank you for coming.

lines.text: You guys obviously recognized that.
It is true there are great engineers everywhere.

glossary.easy: 누가 봐도 알 수 있을 만큼 확실하게
glossary.ex: He was obviously tired after the trip.
glossary.exKo: 그는 여행 후 분명히 피곤해 보였다.

lines.text: But it is the company's choice.
It is the company's choice to figure out and decide who to let in and who not to.

glossary.ex: I can't figure out how this works.
glossary.tip: 회화에서 정말 자주 쓰는 구동사. find out은 '정보를 알게 되다', figure out은 '머리를 써서 알아내다'.

glossary.ex: The guard wouldn't let us in.

lines.text: It is the company's choice to select among all those great engineers.

It is the company's choice to decide what kind of engineers irrespective of their talent but also their character and their personalities and the value systems to let into the company. It is our choice.

glossary.ex: Anyone can join, irrespective of age.
glossary.exKo: 나이와 관계없이 누구나 참여할 수 있다.
glossary.vs: regardless of와 같은 뜻이고, irrespective of가 좀 더 격식 있다.

glossary.easy: 무엇이 옳고 중요한지에 대한 사람의 생각 체계
glossary.ex: We share the same value systems.

lines.text: That choice ultimately goes into what the bucket I call "culture."
We are intensely selective in our company with respect to engineers.

glossary.ex: Ultimately, it's your decision.

glossary.easy: 아무나 뽑지 않고 아주 엄격하게 고르는
glossary.ex: The school is intensely selective about students.
glossary.exKo: 그 학교는 학생 선발이 매우 까다롭다.

glossary.ex: With respect to your question, I'll answer later.
glossary.tip: '존중'의 respect가 아니다. regarding과 같은 뜻의 격식 표현.

lines.text: We hire, we make offers statistics that I just recently learned.
We make offers to one-tenth, 10% of the people we interview.

glossary.ex: They made me an offer after the second interview.
glossary.exKo: 두 번째 면접 후 그들이 나에게 채용 제안을 했다.
glossary.tip: job offer = 채용 제안, accept an offer = 제안을 수락하다.

lines.text: Out of those 10%, 95% accept our offers.
And so, we happen to be intensely selective when it comes down to the people that we bring to our company.

glossary.easy: 어떤 주제를 이야기할 때, 특히 그 핵심에 있어서는
glossary.nuance: 'when it comes to'와 비슷하지만 down이 붙으면 '결국 핵심은'이라는 느낌이 강해진다.
glossary.ex: When it comes down to it, family is what matters most.
glossary.exKo: 결국 따지고 보면 가장 중요한 건 가족이다.

lines.text: Not just alone in their intelligence but also their heart, you know, and also their courage.
We try to figure out whether this person has brains, guts, and heart in the process of the interview.

glossary.nuance: 원래 뜻은 '내장'. 구어에서는 courage보다 거칠고 직설적인 '깡, 배짱'.
glossary.ex: It takes guts to quit your job and start a business.
glossary.tip: 보통 복수형 guts로 쓴다. have the guts to ~ = ~할 배짱이 있다.

lines.text: And that's why people say, "Gee, NVIDIA sure has a rigorous interviewing process. It's because we're trying to select the people that we want to work with.
And it's again no different than a football team.

glossary.ex: The training program is rigorous.
Running a company is no different than coaching a team.
glossary.exKo: 회사를 운영하는 건 팀을 코치하는 것과 다를 바 없다.

lines.text: As a quarterback, you want to know that when you let the ball go, the wide receiver is going to be there to catch the ball.
You don't want to be questioning it.

glossary.ex: Wait until he's open before you let the ball go.
glossary.exKo: 그가 빈 공간에 들어갈 때까지 기다렸다가 공을 던져.

glossary.ex: Stop questioning every decision I make.
glossary.exKo: 내가 내리는 결정마다 의심하지 좀 마.

lines.text: You want to know you have the world's best wide receiver.
That person also has to be your teammate.
Yet there needs to be an element of trust, element of respect.

glossary.easy: 어떤 성질이 일정 부분 들어 있는 것
glossary.ex: There's an element of luck in every success.
glossary.exKo: 모든 성공에는 어느 정도 운이 따른다.

lines.text: And so, I think that the selection process which is what the culture does, OK? And the retention process which is what the culture permits is very important to me. Not everybody likes working at NVIDIA and people I've heard may say that NVIDIA is an institution.

glossary.easy: 좋은 직원이 회사를 떠나지 않고 계속 남게 하는 것
glossary.ex: Employee retention is a big problem for startups.
Smoking is not permitted here.

lines.text: But we're not a church or a prison. Not everybody gets to come.

glossary.ko: 아무나 들어올 수 있는 건 아니다
glossary.easy: 모든 사람에게 들어올 기회가 주어지는 건 아니다
glossary.ex: Not everybody gets to work with such a great team.
glossary.exKo: 누구나 이렇게 좋은 팀과 일할 수 있는 건 아니다.
glossary.tip: get to + 동사 = '~할 기회를 얻다'. 회화에서 아주 자주 쓴다.

lines.text: Not everybody has to stay. But the people that do, love working there because we give them terrific projects. We give them extraordinary resources. And we also give them teammates that they know they can count on. That I think falls into the round of culture and that sets us apart. The reason why a lot of people in

glossary.ex: You did a terrific job.
glossary.tip: terrible(끔찍한)과 비슷해 보이지만 정반대의 긍정적인 뜻.

glossary.easy: 필요할 때 그 사람이 도와줄 거라고 믿다
glossary.ex: You can always count on me.
glossary.vs: rely on과 비슷하고, count on이 더 구어적이고 따뜻한 느낌.

glossary.easy: 다른 사람들과 다르게, 더 돋보이게 만들다
glossary.ex: Great service is what sets this restaurant apart.
glossary.exKo: 훌륭한 서비스가 이 식당을 돋보이게 만든다.

lines.text: the Silicon Valley think that we have one of the best engineering organizations in the world is because of that. That self selection process that makes it possible for us to maintain quality.

glossary.easy: 맞는 사람은 스스로 오고, 안 맞는 사람은 스스로 떠나는 과정
glossary.ex: Self selection means only motivated people apply.
glossary.exKo: 자기 선택이 작동해서 의욕 있는 사람들만 지원한다.

glossary.ex: It's hard to maintain quality as a company grows.
